quotes.confounding: Patients who had TXA were older, had significantly higher ISS, and suffered more penetrating trauma than those in the no-TXA group (Table 1). Patients who received TXA were more shocked on admission to hospital (P < 0.01) and more coagulopathic
quotes.selection: All adult trauma patients (>15 years) admitted to the critical care unit following trauma team activation were recruited. We retrospectively excluded patients found to have an injury severity score (ISS) less than 15.
quotes.classification: At the start of the study period, TXA 1 g was administered in the ED within 3 hours of injury... From February 2011, TXA was formally introduced into the major hemorrhage protocol
quotes.overall: Differences in baseline characteristics (severity of injury, shock state) suggest significant potential for residual confounding despite multivariate adjustment.
